148.news_title: 15khz is Standard on Arcooda Checkmate Monitors
148.long_description: 15khz and other arcade resolutions come standard on the Arcooda Checkmate monitor. Native input is available via RGB/VGA where the Arcooda software auto adjusts the picture quickly to fill the screen. Many more functions will be announced soon with preorder opening this month. In the image below, we show arcade game board (via JAMMA connection) Bloody Roar 2 from Hudson Soft/Raising 1998. We show arcade game board NBA Jam from Midway 1993 in the video, also connected via JAMMA arcade wiring into the Arcooda Checkmate Monitor.
